quantity_datatype.scope: Locked quantity representation; not a new universal ontology range or canonical decimal lexical spelling

equivalence_policy: Numeric equality uses decimal value, without tolerance. Exact RDF-term obligations are distinct and retain hasValue semantics.
authorization_policy: Independently reproduce source/contract-backed leaf evidence; bind exact clause to preceding candidate version/hash. Preserve all other functional RDF triples.
supported_numeric_replacement: Equal inclusive bounds at the exact authorized property locator, retaining datatype and presence; numeric comparison may already exist.
not_proved: Arbitrary SPARQL equivalence, unconstrained multiplicities and logical encodings outside supported explicit property/node trees
